# Iconic construction site at TITLIS

With the opening of the TITLIS Tower, the first major milestone of the TITLIS project has been reached. At over 3,000 meters above sea level, a new architectural landmark has taken shape, designed by the renowned architecture firm Herzog & de Meuron. Set amid snow, rock, and glacier, the TITLIS Tower opens up new perspectives on the mountain world and marks a new chapter in alpine architecture.

At the same time, the next important phase of the project is beginning: the transformation of the existing mountain station into the new TITLIS Peak Station, scheduled to open in 2029. This means the TITLIS project remains one of Europe’s highest-altitude mountain construction sites and a milestone of modern architecture under some of the most demanding conditions.

Good to know: During the construction period, temporary changes to visitor routes may still occur. At times, there may also be construction noise, and rock material from the works may be visible on the snow. Temporary facilities will also remain in place near the Berghotel Trübsee as part of the project. All attractions remain open as usual, and the panorama is as breathtaking as ever.

[Learn more](https://www.titlis.ch/en/information/future-proof)

#### Activities

### Skiing

Whether you prefer racing down the slopes, carving smooth turns or mastering the stem turn, Engelberg-Titlis offers 82 kilometres of perfectly groomed pistes for skiing just the way you like it.

[Learn more](https://www.titlis.ch/en/activities/skiing)

![TITLIS Rotair](https://www.titlis.ch/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.titlis.ch%2Fimages%2F6ngkbe24%2Fproduction%2Fcd4fe6b610246de13d89923f1604131910366248-1920x1080.jpg%3Fq%3D70%26auto%3Dformat&w=3840&q=75)

## TITLIS Rotair

Revolutionary technology meets breathtaking nature! Experience the glacier panorama from a spectacular 360-degree perspective in the world's first revolving cable car!

![](https://www.titlis.ch/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.titlis.ch%2Fimages%2F6ngkbe24%2Fproduction%2Fa95ff3de450644ee312e7a83f3ad223936f46eac-1771x1771.png%3Fq%3D70%26auto%3Dformat&w=3840&q=75)

[Learn more](https://www.titlis.ch/en/activities/titlis-rotair)

![Ice Flyer](https://www.titlis.ch/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.titlis.ch%2Fimages%2F6ngkbe24%2Fproduction%2F57297b1781a01d8c3e92f0fe89649ae24624bdc6-1920x1080.jpg%3Fq%3D70%26auto%3Dformat&w=3840&q=75)

### Ice Flyer

The experience of flying high above the deep-blue crevasses will change you. A flight between ice and eternity.

[Learn more](https://www.titlis.ch/en/activities/ice-flyer)

![Glacier Cave](https://www.titlis.ch/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.titlis.ch%2Fimages%2F6ngkbe24%2Fproduction%2F4885f16e0e6ae1d33de76aa9d6eb4e964ce0d87d-1920x1080.jpg%3Fw%3D1280%26q%3D70%26auto%3Dformat&w=3840&q=75)

### Glacier Cave

Pioneers can explore the 5,000-year-old heart of the glacier and feel its energy with their own hands.

[Learn more](https://www.titlis.ch/en/activities/glacier-cave)

![Cliff Walk](https://www.titlis.ch/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.titlis.ch%2Fimages%2F6ngkbe24%2Fproduction%2F262708f6c554275acfc0f395e7f9b14379cf2cc7-1920x1080.jpg%3Fw%3D1280%26q%3D70%26auto%3Dformat&w=3840&q=75)

### Cliff Walk

Courage and a spirit of adventure are called for on Europe's highest suspension bridge. You'll be rewarded with breathtaking views down into the icy depths. A moment for all eternity.

[Learn more](https://www.titlis.ch/en/activities/titlis-cliff-walk)

#### \#HighCuisine

![Joseph's Restaurant](https://www.titlis.ch/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.titlis.ch%2Fimages%2F6ngkbe24%2Fproduction%2F77c050951f4173abd981fda27f2d47fd0463052e-1440x810.jpg%3Fw%3D834%26q%3D70%26auto%3Dformat&w=1920&q=75)

##### Joseph's Restaurant

* * *

Joseph’s Restaurant in the spectacular TITLIS Tower at 3,020 metres is now open. Experience casual fine dining at its finest, paired with breathtaking panoramic views that make every moment special. Reserve your table today and discover one of the Alps’ most unique culinary experiences.

[Learn more](https://www.titlis.ch/en/restaurants/joseph-s-restaurant)

![Atelier Hess](https://www.titlis.ch/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.titlis.ch%2Fimages%2F6ngkbe24%2Fproduction%2Fbaa9f5d8de3bfd146cae1d44c2c631408eb1fc8f-1920x1080.jpg%3Fw%3D834%26q%3D70%26auto%3Dformat&w=1920&q=75)

##### Atelier Hess

* * *

At 1,800 metres above sea level, we combine tradition and innovation to create a unique culinary experience. Inspired by the Engelberg pioneer Eugen Hess-Waser, Atelier Hess reinterprets alpine cuisine – pure, refined, and full of character. Here, every course becomes a tribute to the mountains.

[Learn more](https://www.titlis.ch/en/restaurants/atelier-hess)

![Lago Torbido](https://www.titlis.ch/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.titlis.ch%2Fimages%2F6ngkbe24%2Fproduction%2Fdfcbe7d7a95ef75c89a2e76368c8739cf28cf500-1200x801.jpg%3Fw%3D834%26q%3D70%26auto%3Dformat&w=1920&q=75)

##### Lago Torbido

* * *

A taste of Italy in the heart of the ski area! Located at Trübsee middle station, Lago Torbido offers authentic Italian cuisine, bags of style and plenty of charm!

[Learn more](https://www.titlis.ch/en/restaurants/lago-torbido)

![Stand Ski Hut](https://www.titlis.ch/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.titlis.ch%2Fimages%2F6ngkbe24%2Fproduction%2F4739a361d27d3ed5f3156f424158682bfbbde161-6000x4000.jpg%3Fw%3D2560%26q%3D70%26auto%3Dformat&w=1920&q=75)

##### Stand Ski Hut

* * *

Stand ski hut has a classic hut vibe! Here you'll get to experience the Alpine lifestyle in a cosy setting.

[Learn more](https://www.titlis.ch/en/restaurants/stand-ski-hut)

![Truebsee Self-Service](https://www.titlis.ch/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.titlis.ch%2Fimages%2F6ngkbe24%2Fproduction%2Ffb9466ce94cf008c160de172d2b01163ac03ce88-6000x4000.jpg%3Fw%3D2560%26q%3D70%26auto%3Dformat&w=1920&q=75)

##### Truebsee Self-Service

* * *

Self-service in a cool industrial look! The newly renovated self-service restaurant at Truebsee offers high-quality food in a modern setting.

[Learn more](https://www.titlis.ch/en/restaurants/truebsee-self-service)

[Show all](https://www.titlis.ch/en/restaurants)

###### Sat, 28. Nov 2026

* * *

##### Moving Mountain Titlis w/Ben Böhmer

MOVING MOUNTAIN brings together what belongs together. Here, the crisp mountain air, sunlit peaks, and serene alpine landscapes create the perfect setting for electronic music, immersive visuals, and unforgettable memories.

[Learn More](https://www.titlis.ch/en/events/moving-mountain-presents-ben-boehmer-at-truebsee)

![Unum In The Mountains presents Sven Väth at Truebsee, Titlis](https://www.titlis.ch/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.titlis.ch%2Fimages%2F6ngkbe24%2Fproduction%2Fb047eefd15b22270a246fdfdcf6442b826bd8c33-1254x1254.png%3Fw%3D834%26q%3D70%26auto%3Dformat&w=1920&q=75)

###### Sun, 29. Nov 2026

* * *

##### Unum In The Mountains presents Sven Väth at Truebsee, Titlis

Unum heads for the swiss alps!

[Learn More](https://www.titlis.ch/en/events/unum-in-the-mountains-presents-sven-vaeth-at-truebsee)

![Major Bächli ski test](https://www.titlis.ch/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.titlis.ch%2Fimages%2F6ngkbe24%2Fproduction%2F47a4a309b2e3c535b9c8db86d876a4b02cab528b-1920x1280.jpg%3Fw%3D834%26q%3D70%26auto%3Dformat&w=1920&q=75)

###### Sat, 05. Dec 2026 - Mon, 07. Dec 2026

* * *

##### Major Bächli ski test

Looking for new touring or freeride skis? Test the latest models from Bächli Bergsport from the 2026/27 winter season and find your perfect ski.

[Learn More](https://www.titlis.ch/en/events/baechli-skitest)

![Ski-In Party-Out - New Year's Eve in the Mountains](https://www.titlis.ch/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.titlis.ch%2Fimages%2F6ngkbe24%2Fproduction%2F98682a1ab8992fc02826c23633be83c5f2f685bf-3481x2161.png%3Fw%3D2560%26q%3D70%26auto%3Dformat&w=1920&q=75)

###### Thu, 31. Dec 2026

* * *

##### Ski-In Party-Out - New Year's Eve in the Mountains

Say goodbye to the old year in style at the Truebsee Alpine Lodge and welcome the new one with a lively celebration in the chalet.

[Learn More](https://www.titlis.ch/en/events/ski-in-party-out-silvester)

[Show all](https://www.titlis.ch/en/events)
